title: Organising a Community Lantern Festival
instructions: 这是一份为B1水平学习者设计的原创英语听力与语法练习材料（模拟教学材料，非官方雅思试题）。请先听/读对话，完成8道听力理解题；然后学习语法讲解并完成8道语法题；最后进行口语和写作迁移练习。所有题目答案均来自材料原文，请仔细阅读。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. Are you free on Saturday? We are organising a lantern festival in the community hall.
Ben: A lantern festival? That sounds fun. What do you need help with?
Mia: Well, I was making lanterns yesterday when my sister called. She said she could help too. While I was cutting paper, she was painting the lanterns.
Ben: Great. Who is the person in charge of the food?
Mia: That's Mr. Chen. He is the man who owns the noodle shop on Green Street. He was cooking soup when I asked him.
Ben: Nice. And which room are we using?
Mia: Room 2, the big room which has a stage. We were moving tables there when the caretaker told us to stop.
Ben: Why did he stop you?
Mia: He said the floor was wet. So we waited. While we were waiting, we talked about the programme.
Ben: What programme?
Mia: There is a story-telling corner for children, and a dance show that starts at seven. The dance group which practises here every week will perform.
Ben: I see. Was anyone taking photos last year?
Mia: Yes, a student who studies photography took them. This year, we want someone who can make a short video too.
Ben: I can do that. I was learning video editing last month.
Mia: Perfect! While you were learning, we were planning the posters. Can you come at five?
Ben: Sure. I'll bring my camera which has a good microphone.
Mia: Thanks, Ben. See you on Saturday!

grammar.title: 过去进行时与定语从句入门
grammar.explanation: 过去进行时表示过去某个时刻正在进行的动作，结构是 was/were + 动词-ing。常与 when（这时）或 while（当……时）连用：when 后常接短暂动作（一般过去时），while 后常接持续动作（过去进行时）。例如：I was making lanterns when my sister called. / While I was cutting paper, she was painting. 定语从句用来修饰名词，who 指人，which 指物，that 可指人或物。例如：the man who owns the shop（开店的男人），the room which has a stage（有舞台的房间）。
grammar.example: I was making lanterns yesterday when my sister called.

options: I was cooking when the phone rang.
I cooked when the phone was ringing.
I was cook when the phone rang.
answers: I was cooking when the phone rang.
questions.explanation: 过去进行时表示正在进行的动作，when 后接短暂动作 rang，所以选第一句。
questions.evidence: I was making lanterns yesterday when my sister called.

questions.prompt: While we ______ for the bus, it started to rain.
questions.explanation: while 后常接过去进行时，表示持续动作，主语 we 用 were waiting。
questions.evidence: While we were waiting, we talked about the programme.

questions.prompt: The woman ______ teaches us English is very kind.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the woman 指人，定语从句用 who。
questions.evidence: He is the man who owns the noodle shop on Green Street.

questions.prompt: This is the book ______ I bought yesterday.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the book 指物，定语从句用 which。
questions.evidence: the big room which has a stage

options: She was reading a book when I came in.
She read a book when I was coming in.
She was read a book when I came in.
answers: She was reading a book when I came in.
questions.explanation: 过去进行时 was reading 表示正在读书，when 后接 came in 表示短暂动作。
questions.evidence: I was making lanterns yesterday when my sister called.

questions.prompt: The dog ______ is barking belongs to my neighbour.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the dog 指物，that 可指物，在从句中作主语。
questions.evidence: a dance show that starts at seven

questions.prompt: While I ______ dinner, my brother was watching TV.
questions.explanation: while 引导持续动作，主句用过去进行时，从句也用过去进行时，主语 I 用 was cooking。
questions.evidence: While I was cutting paper, she was painting the lanterns.

questions.prompt: The girl ______ won the prize is my cousin.
questions.explanation: 先行词 the girl 指人，定语从句用 who。
